notes: Modified cash basis city; basis recorded as cash. Governmental: Total Governmental Funds statement (pp4-5, 3). Beginning/ending cash = beginning/ending fund balance (all fund balance is cash/CDs/investments per p3). Debt service 53,200 printed under Other financing uses is recorded as disbursements (outside_printed_total) rather than a transfer, split into 40,000 principal and 13,200 interest (interest per p2 Statement of Activities). Roll-forward: 970,634.45 + 906,387.48 - 900,137.15 - 53,200 = 923,684.78. Business-type (Water, Sewer, Junkyard) from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position (p7), accrual basis; Total column; operating expenses assigned function utilities. Cash flow statement on p8 not used (proprietary field null since not GAAP-basis city). Balance sheet uses the government-wide Statement of Net Position Totals column (p1), which mixes modified-cash governmental and accrual business-type. Budget-and-actual All Funds schedule (p9) mixes fund types and is recorded in detail: governmental function lines (add to 900,137.15) are governmental; Junkyard/Sewer/Water business-type; revenue lines have no fund-type split and are recorded by dominant fund type with review (Charges for services and Interest business-type, the rest governmental); all-funds debt service split by fund type using p2/p7/p8 figures (computed).
